0022600140.text: The Nuggets (1-1, 7th in the West) are on the road for their fourth game of the season, coming off a win, while the Pelicans (0-3, 13th in the West) are looking to snap a three-game losing streak. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise). The Nuggets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 141-135 win in Denver on October 24, and they won all three meetings in 2025-26.
